opportunity.title: Open Architecture Platform for Underwater Vehicles for Rapid Adaptation, Collaborative Sensing, Navigation, and Autonomy

claims_boundary: Worldshepherd does not claim an operational AUV, flooded-hull platform, underwater propulsion system, acoustic modem, hydrodynamic test article, 24-hour underwater endurance, or at-sea validation.
Existing APNT, link-loss, and mission-replay fixtures are synthetic software evidence only and do not satisfy DARPA's physical AUV feasibility requirements.
No partner interest, DP2 eligibility, award probability, or proposal submission is claimed.
Any underwater navigation or communication capability must be validated separately from surface, air, or generic synthetic scenarios.

darpa_required_feasibility_domains.darpa_requirement: Data demonstrating capability to model propulsion performance, vehicle dynamics, and hydrodynamic signatures of underwater platforms.
Data demonstrating ability to characterize, localize, and estimate acoustic signatures of individual platforms or multi-vehicle formations.
Analytical or algorithmic proof supporting stable formation control and consensus under degraded communications or platform performance.

existing_worldshepherd_evidence.relevance: Models progressive GNSS degradation, alternate-PNT cross-check, confidence states, policy-gated recovery, and mission replay; useful as a software assurance pattern but not underwater-navigation validation.
Exercises connection loss, reconnect behavior, checksum failure, and policy-service outage; useful for DDIL software assurance but not proof of underwater mesh performance.
Exercises communications degradation, stale sensor dependencies, task failure, operator override, and replayable follow-on proposals; useful for fleet evidence and post-mission analysis.
Can route hypotheses, contradictions, mission events, provenance, and policy-gated actions without self-authorizing consequential execution.

phase_ii_milestone_fit.darpa_milestone: Hardware/software interface standards, mesh baseline, external battery architecture, and AI-driven mission planning ecosystem.
phase_ii_milestone_fit.worldshepherd_role: Open interface/evidence schema, mission-planning governance, configuration custody, and verification hooks; hardware and battery architecture require platform partner.

phase_ii_milestone_fit.darpa_milestone: Physics-based pre-deployment simulation plus core autonomy including objective-based mission planning and market-based task allocation.
phase_ii_milestone_fit.worldshepherd_role: PVK/SARA integration, scenario generation, mission replay, confidence/provenance, and red-team injection; hydrodynamic truth model requires validated domain model and data.

phase_ii_milestone_fit.darpa_milestone: Multimodal acoustic/RF/cellular/SATCOM mesh and initial in-water validation of stationkeeping, propulsion endurance, and connectivity.
phase_ii_milestone_fit.worldshepherd_role: Mesh-state provenance, degraded-link policy, failover/recovery verification, and evidence replay; physical modem/network and in-water evidence require partner.

phase_ii_milestone_fit.darpa_milestone: Heterogeneous fleet with retasking, deconfliction, collaborative sensing, and automated data offload.
phase_ii_milestone_fit.worldshepherd_role: Task/action provenance, policy-gated retasking, conflict detection, multi-vehicle replay, and auditability; physical fleet and collaborative sensing remain partner-led.

capture_decision.reason: The DP2 feasibility gate requires physical/domain evidence not present in the current Worldshepherd repository, while several software-assurance and mission-lifecycle functions are directly complementary to a qualified AUV platform team.
minimum_partner_evidence_needed: AUV hydrodynamic/propulsion model validated against experimental or in-water data.
Formation-control and degraded-communications evidence applicable to underwater vehicles.
Physical open-architecture AUV development path compatible with two-person portability and up-to-24-hour operation.
Ability to execute in-water and at-sea demonstrations on the required schedule.

worldshepherd_partner_contribution_packa: SARA mission-state orchestration with bounded authority and policy gates.
ECHO-style configuration, sensor, communications, task, and model provenance.
APNT confidence/recovery logic adapted only after underwater sensor/navigation validation.
DDIL link-loss/failover test orchestration across acoustic, RF, cellular, and SATCOM interfaces.
Mission replay and post-mission causal analysis for retasking, stale data, deconfliction, and task failure.
WS-OMEGA contradiction, negative-space, and falsification test generation for predeployment simulation campaigns.
PRIME claims/authorization gates preventing software test results from being promoted to physical AUV capability without evidence.
next_actions: Screen at least five AUV platform/acoustics teams against the three DP2 feasibility domains before outreach.

Build an underwater-specific synthetic mission fixture with acoustic-link intermittency, INS/DVL drift, depth/pressure state, delayed surfacing communications, and heterogeneous-vehicle retasking; label it synthetic and do not treat it as physical evidence.
Create a partner evidence checklist that requires hydrodynamic, acoustic, formation-control, endurance, modular payload, and at-sea evidence before Worldshepherd recommends teaming.
Keep prime status NO-GO unless qualifying physical/domain evidence is added and independently reviewed.
